paite: Huan Abraham in zi dang anei nawn a, amin Keturah ahi.
heading: Abraham Suan Dangte / ( Kro 1.32,33)
english: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

paite: Ama'n Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak leh Shuah aneihsak hi.
english: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

paite: Jokshan in tapa Sheba leh Dedan anei a, Dedan tapate Asshurim leh Letushim leh Leummim ahi uh.
english: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

paite: Midian tapate Ephah, Epher, Hanok, Abidah leh Eldaah ahi uh. Huai tengteng Keturah tate ahi uhi.
english: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

paite: Abraham in aneih tengteng Isak apia hi.
english: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

paite: Amei tapate kiang ah Abraham in thilpiakte apia a; amah dam lai ngei in atapa Isak a kipan amaute suahlam gam ah asawlkhia hi.
english: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

paite: Abraham damsung kum zakhat sawmsagih-le-nga ahi.
heading: Abraham Sihna Leh Vuina
english: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

paite: Abraham in akha akhahta a, lu a kelsam pou vek in tekkun a dam in asi a, achipihte kiang a pi in a-omta hi.
english: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

paite: Atapa Isak leh Ishmael in Hit mi Zohar tapa Ephron lou a, Mamre phak ma a Makpelah kokhuk ah avui uhi.
english: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

paite: Huai lou, Abraham in Heth suante a pan aleisa ahi a, huai mun ah azi Sarah kiang ah Abraham vui in a-om hi.
english: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Abraham sih nung in, Pathian in atapa Isak avualzawl a; Beer-lahai-roi ah Isak ateng hi.
english: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

paite: Hiaite Abraham tapa Ishmael, Sarah sikhanu, Aigupta mi Hagar in Abraham aneihsak suante ahi uh.
heading: Ishmael Suante / (1 Kro 1.28-31)
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

paite: Hiaite amin chiat uleh asuante uh dungzui zel in Ishmael tapate min ahi. Ishmael tapa upapen Nebajoth ahi a, huai ban ah Kedar, Adbeel leh Mibsam,
english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

paite: Mishma, Dumah leh Massa,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

paite: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish leh Kedemah ahi uh.
english: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

paite: Huaite Ishmael tapate ahi ua, huaite akhua uh bang leh agiahphual uh dungzui zel a amin uh gelh ahi a, anam uh bang zel in vaihawmmi sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

paite: Ishmael damsung kum zakhat sawmthum-le-sagih ahi a; akha khah in asi a, achipihte kiang ah pi in a-omta hi.
english: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

paite: Atapate Havilah gam a kipan Assuria gam lam a Aigupta gam phak ma a Shur tan in ateng ua, a-unau dang teng a kipan atuamten uhi.
english: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

paite: Hiaite Abraham tapa Isak suante ahi ua: Abraham in tapa Isak anei hi.
heading: Esau Leh Jakob Pianna
english: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

paite: Isak in Padan-aram gam a Siria mi Bethuel tanu, Aram mi Laban sanggamnu Rebekah zi a aneih lai in kum sawmli a upa ahi.
english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

paite: Azi achiin ziak in Isak in TOUPA kiang ah azi a ding in nget petmah in angetsak hi. TOUPA'N angetna angaihkhiaksak a, azi Rebekah ahong gaita hi.
english: Isaac entreated Yahweh for his wife, because she was barren. Yahweh was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

paite: Asung a anaupaite akisual ua; ama'n, "Hichibang ahih ngalleh, bangziak in ahia, ka hi chih?" achi a; TOUPA dong ding in akuanta hi.
english: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'n akiang ah, "Na sul ah nam nih a-om ua, na gilsung a kipan nam nih akikhen ding uh, nam khat sang in nam khat ahatzaw ding a, a-upazaw in anaupangzaw nna asem ding,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

paite: Anau neih ahun in, ngai in, asul ah phik a-om hi.
english: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

paite: Amasazaw asan a san seksawk, puanmul bang a mul thiapthuap in ahong suakkhia a, amin Esau asa uhi.
english: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

paite: Huai nung in anau hong suakkhe nawn a, akhut in Esau khetul alenkip a; ama min Jakob asa uhi. Rebekah in amaute aneih lai in Isak kum sawmguk a upa ahi.
english: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

paite: Naupangte hong khanglian ua; Esau sabetsiam, gamvakmi ahi a; Jakob mimelmawl, puaninte a tengmi ahi.
heading: Esau In Ta Masa Ahihna Azuak
english: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

paite: Isak in asamatte anek zel ziak in Esau a-it a; Rebekah in bel Jakob a-it hi.
english: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

paite: Jakob in betang ahuan laitak in Esau gamkuan ahong tung a, atawl mahmah hi.
english: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

paite: Esau in Jakob kiang ah, "Hehpih in na betang huan hon nesak in; ka bah mahmah hi,” achi hi. Huaiziak in ahi amin Edom achih uh.
english: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

paite: Jakob in, "Na ta masa hihna hon leisak phot lechin,” achi hi.
english: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

paite: Esau in, "Ngai in, si dek ka hi ngal a; kei a ding in hiai ta masa hihna bang aphatuam dia?" achi hi.
english: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

paite: Jakob in, "Tuni in ka kiang ah kichiam phot in,” achi hi. Akiang ah akichiam a, Jakob kiang ah ata masa hihna akhawng maimah hi.
english: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

paite: Jakob in Esau tanghou leh abetang huan apia a; ama'n ne in adawn a, athou a, apaikheta hi. Huchibang in Esau in ata masa hihna angaineu hi.
english: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.
